attchmntText: Lumax Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Extension of the term of Mr. Raajesh Kumar Gupta as the Company Secretary (Key Managerial Personnel designated as Senior Management Personnel) of the Company for a period of One (1) year with effect from January O 1, 202 7 consequent to attaining the age of Superannuation on December 3 1, 2026 based on the recommendation of the Nomination & Remuneration Committee.
Lumax Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Outcome of the Board Meeting held on Monday, October 26, 2026.

Lumax Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about the Earnings call for all Investors/General Public is scheduled to be held on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 11.00 A.M. (IST) to discuss the Operational and Financial performance of the Company for the 2nd Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026
Lumax Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under Regulation 74(5) of the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026.
desc: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
